body:
Founder: 'we need to fix SHANKPIT PFSP pipeline it dont work.' Live-reproduced the real TimeoutError running the actual training pipeline; root cause was ensure_slot_for_sender() minting a permanent un-welcomed phantom slot for a stray USERCMD packet from a timed-out sender (only PACKET_CONNECT should allocate a slot). Fixed in apps/server/src/main.c, verified deterministically with zero slot activity for an unconnected USERCMD sender. go build clean, 13 Go tests + 39 Python tests green. SHANKPIT commit pending.

⚓ ☃
title: fix(net): phantom-slot livelock breaking PFSP self-play RL training under CPU contention
